title: Leni Robredo thanks PCSO for P25-M Naga hospital equipment

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Naga City Mayor Maria Leonor “Leni” Robredo, a former vice president, praised the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) for donating ₱25.1 million worth of diagnostic equipment to Naga City General Hospital, according to a PCSO statement issued on Friday. “We are beyond grateful, not just for these donations, but for what PCSO has been doing for our countrymen,” Robredo said on Thursday during the turnover of the donation, which was held amid the city’s Peñafrancia Festival festivities. “Frequently, you’re the last line of defense.
